name: execution-policy
description: Set and verify the machine-wide PowerShell ExecutionPolicy (LocalMachine = RemoteSigned). Replaces the MANUAL step bootstrap.ps1 only printed, which was skipped on mast04 (2026-07-07) and mast03 (2026-07-08) and fixed by hand both times. Runs FIRST (order 10): it is the precondition every bare 'powershell -File' depends on. Set-ExecutionPolicy writes the registry and THEN throws SecurityException/ExecutionPolicyOverride whenever a more permissive scope shadows the one written -- which our own '-ExecutionPolicy Bypass' wrapper always does -- so the outcome is taken from reading the policy back, never from the absence of an exception. Verify re-reads the LIVE policy (not just the smoke marker) and fails on a Group Policy scope, which outranks LocalMachine and makes a correct persisted value meaningless. always:true because policy changed out of band produces no payload-hash drift, so nothing else would ever look. See #51.
